title: Standoff in the Vast Sky
next_chapter_hook: The Eye of Heavenly Way sneered: Chen Ji's rebellion was already marked in the causal web ten thousand years ago

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's warning burned into Chen Ji's mind like a brand—'Completely inheriting this legacy will forever cost you the chance of rebirth.' At this moment, he finally understood, there was no path left. Behind him was the endless abyss, before him the heaven-encompassing net woven by ten thousand years of causality, and he stood precisely at the center of this chess game.

Above the vast sky, a giant eye slowly opened. Its size far exceeded a thousand li, within its pupil churned chaos and reincarnation, as if being gazed upon by it sealed one's destiny. Pressure descended like tangible substance, enveloping the Three Realms. Mountains and rivers trembled, all beings knelt in submission. Only Chen Ji stood at the epicenter of that pressure, garments fluttering, yet his eyes remained placid as still water.

dialogue.content: A contemptible existence dares to covet what should not belong to you?

text.content: The Eye of Heavenly Way's voice did not come from his ears, but rang directly within Chen Ji's Mental Sea. It was an irresistible will, as if the entire heavens and earth were set against him. However, Chen Ji merely slightly curved his lips, that arc hiding a sarcasm that ten thousand years of schemes could not fathom.

dialogue.content: Heavenly Way? Hmph, I thought it would be some formidable existence. So it is merely an old fox hiding behind the causal web, manipulating the fates of all beings.

text.content: As the words fell, the giant eye above the vast sky slightly contracted, as if pricked by something. The Eye of Heavenly Way's pressure surged anew, and all beings in the Three Realms caught the scent of doom. Within the Three Realms, every living creature involuntarily knelt, only Chen Ji remained standing upright, his spine never bending even an inch.

dialogue.content: Your arrogance reminds this One of that equally foolish observer from ten thousand years ago. He too once laughed defiantly at heaven's end, claiming to have seen through the Heavenly Secrets. And the result? He merely turned into a wisp of remnant soul, barely clinging to existence trapped within your so-called inheritance.

text.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly within the Tianji Record. He knew the Eye of Heavenly Way spoke true—the First Observer had indeed been defeated, utterly and completely. But Chen Ji was not the First Observer. The Tianji Record Fragment in his hand slowly rotated within his Mental Sea, and the Fate Observation Eye quietly opened.

In an instant, Chen Ji saw it. He saw what lay hidden beneath the Eye of Heavenly Way's overbearing pressure. It was a net, a massive web woven from ten thousand years of causality, entangling all things in the Three Realms. And the Eye of Heavenly Way was precisely the master of that net.

dialogue.content: Ten thousand years of scheming, using generations of prophets as chess pieces, causality as threads, fate as bait. You think you are arranging some grand game? Hmph, you are merely harvesting the causal power of all beings to sustain your own projection's existence!

text.content: At these words, the giant eye above the vast sky violently contracted. The Eye of Heavenly Way's pressure surged to a terrifying degree. Chen Ji felt as if his very soul would be crushed by this pressure. Yet he gritted his teeth and forcefully endured. The Tianji Record Fragment spun madly, the Fate Observation Eye and the Eye of Heavenly Way confronted each other across the void.

dialogue.content: Interesting. In ten thousand years, you are the first to dare gaze directly at This One and attempt to find This One's weakness. But do you know? It is precisely this rebellion that makes this chess game even more interesting. Come then, let This One see just how much this contemptible creature can struggle!

text.content: At Chen Ji's brow center, that vertical pupil suddenly opened wide. The Fate Observation Eye erupted with brilliant light, directly crashing into that overwhelming pressure. In an instant, a thunderclap seemed to resound between heaven and earth. The Eye of Heavenly Way's pressure was forcibly pushed aside at a corner, and that giant eye displayed a shocked expression for the first time.

choices.text: Exposing the Heavenly Way's Ten-Thousand-Year Flaw with Words
choices.description: Not clashing head-on with it, but using truth as a weapon, forcing the Eye of Heavenly Way into a passive position
choices.visible_cost: Exposing Part of the Hidden Cards
choices.visible_reward: The Eye of Heavenly Way's Pressure Becomes Chaotic

dialogue.content: The Eye of the Heavenly Dao, you think I don't know? Your true form perished in the causal tribulation ten thousand years ago. What remains of you now is merely a projection sustained by a lingering will through the causal forces of all creation! What are you afraid of? Afraid that I will seize the web you have been weaving for ten thousand years!

text.content: At these words, the giant eye above the celestial dome trembled violently. The oppressive pressure began to falter, and the circulation of chaos and reincarnation grew unstable. Chen Ji keenly caught this subtle change, and the curve of his lips deepened a fraction more.

choices.text: Stake everything on all living beings, awaken the rebellious hearts of the Three Realms
choices.description: Not to confront the Heavenly Dao, but to awaken the living beings enslaved by it, letting them rise up on their own
choices.visible_cost: Expose the true intention of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: The foundation of the Heavenly Dao's Eye begins to waver
choices.risk_hint: The living beings may not respond immediately

text.content: Chen Ji paid no heed to the Heavenly Dao's Eye's oppressive pressure. Instead, he turned toward the Three Realms and proclaimed in a loud voice: 'All sentient beings, hear my command! The Heavenly Dao has bound you with causality as locks and destiny as chains, trapping you in ten thousand years of reincarnation. Are you willing to be mere pieces in this ten-thousand-year chess game? Are you willing to let a remnant will that has long perished continue to enslave your destinies?'

Above the firmament, the Heavenly Dao's Eye fell silent. It was a silence unlike any before, like a wild beast having its tail stepped on, weighing whether to swat flat this ant that dared to provoke a tiger. After a long moment, that voice resounded again, carrying a heaviness it had never possessed.

dialogue.content: You think exposing these truths can change anything? For ten thousand years, countless souls have attempted rebellion, and their ashes have long been scattered by the wind. You are merely another arrogant fool among humans.

text.content: However, Chen Ji smiled. That smile held not a trace of fear; instead, it carried something the Heavenly Dao's Eye had never witnessed in ten thousand years—a nearly manic confidence. He slowly raised his hand, pointing at the giant eye above the firmament.

dialogue.content: Foolish? Heavenly Dao, you mistake meticulous planning for arrogance. Your ten-thousand-year chess game is indeed exquisite, but you forgot one thing—no matter how precise the board, there will always be cracks. And I am the chess player specifically designed to find your flaws!

choice.prompt: Chen Ji's mockery caused the Heavenly Dao's Eye to falter for the first time, and the causal forces within the Three Realms began to descend into chaos—

choices.text: Taking advantage of the Heavenly Dao's wavering, unleash the ultimate profundity of the Tianji Record
choices.description: No more holding back, declare war on the Heavenly Dao with the full power of the Tianji Record

choices.visible_reward: The main body of the Heavenly Dao's Eye sustains its first injury

text.content: Chen Ji's hands formed seals, and the Tianji Record fragments blazed with unprecedented radiance within his Mental Sea. That light pierced through his Mental Sea and shot toward the firmament, colliding with the Heavenly Dao's Eye. In an instant, the heavens darkened and the sun and moon lost their brilliance. All beings in the Three Realms witnessed a crack appear upon that giant eye.

choices.text: Deliberately expose a weakness, lure the Heavenly Dao into attacking
choices.description: Feign weakness to lure the enemy, force the Heavenly Dao to reveal its true trump cards
choices.visible_cost: Sustain a certain degree of damage
choices.visible_reward: Clearly perceive the Heavenly Dao's true strength

text.content: Chen Ji deliberately let the pressure invade his body, staggering back several steps with a trace of blood at the corner of his lips. Yet his eyes were sharp as blades, fixed intently on every subtle change of the Heavenly Eyes. He was gambling—gambling that the Heavens would reveal its true hand when he showed weakness.

The Heavenly Eyes indeed raged. It was the rage of one wounded by an ant, the rage of ten-thousand-year-old majesty being challenged for the first time. It began to take seriously this existence it had once regarded as merely a chess piece.

dialogue.content: Very well, very well. For ten thousand years, I have finally encountered a piece worthy of serious consideration. Since you so desperately wish to witness the true power of the Heavenly Dao... then let me show you what constitutes genuine causality, what embodies true destiny!

text.content: The pupil of the Heavenly Eyes contracted violently, with chaotic power churning within. Chen Ji sensed an unprecedented pressure, a sign that the Heavenly Dao was about to unleash its genuine might. Yet at this critical juncture, an aged yet urgent voice resonated within his Mental Sea—the voice of Mo Xiansheng.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, enough! The first round of probing has achieved its purpose. The Heavenly Dao has sensed the threat, and continuing to fight will only expose more! This is not the moment for a decisive battle; your trump cards are insufficient! Retreat!

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's warning echoed through the Mental Sea, and Chen Ji faced a choice—

choices.text: "Follow Mo Xiansheng's advice and retreat temporarily"
choices.description: "Preserve strength; today's humiliation will be repaid a hundredfold. Leave behind the legend that 'the Heavenly Dao is也不过如此'",

dialogue.content: A trace of unwillingness flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, but he was ultimately that Chen Ji who left nothing to chance. He forcibly suppressed the fighting intent in his heart and sneered: "Enough for today. The Heavenly Dao, remember this—our next meeting will be your end!" With those words, his figure gradually dissolved under the protection of the Observer of Destiny.

choices.text: "Disregard Mo Xiansheng's warning and continue fighting the Heavenly Dao to the death"
choices.description: "Miss today, and who knows when we can force out the Heavenly Dao's true power again"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain crucial intelligence, laying the groundwork for the final showdown"
choices.risk_hint: "Extremely high risk, may affect the subsequent storyline direction"

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, a resolute light flickering in his eyes. Instead of heeding Mo Xiansheng's warning, he channeled the Tianji Record and launched an even fiercer assault. The Heavenly Eyes clearly hadn't expected this ant to dare such madness, and for a moment was actually forced back.

When Chen Ji finally chose to withdraw, the colossal eye above the firmament still gazed at the direction where he vanished. The Heavenly Eyes fell silent—a silence unlike any before. Its pressure gradually receded, and the three realms returned to tranquility, yet everyone knew—this confrontation had fundamentally altered something.

Under the gaze of the Heavenly Eyes, the web of causality in the three realms trembled slightly. Those originally clear threads of fate displayed an almost imperceptible deviation. For the first time in ten thousand years, a variable appeared that it could not entirely control. And that variable was precisely that ant it once disdainfully dismissed—Chen Ji.

After a long while, the Heavenly Eyes slowly spoke, the voice resonating through the Void, carrying a meaning-laden cold smile: "Interesting... For ten thousand years, finally another ant has made me feel even a trace of... threat." The colossal eye slowly closed, but the pressure did not fully dissipate, instead transforming into invisible threads that quietly coiled toward some direction.

In the web of causality, the Heavenly Eyes watched coldly, Chen Ji's trajectory of resistance clearly visible. Yet it did not know that behind this seemingly impulsive decision lay Chen Ji's deeper calculations. Confronting the Heavenly Dao directly was dangerous—but it was also the only method to probe the Heavenly Dao's bottom line and seek a fatal weakness.

The moment Chen Ji vanished, the Heavenly Eyes let out a low, cold laugh. That laughter echoed through the web of causality, carrying the arrogance and confidence of a chess player who had played a ten-thousand-year game. Every thought, every struggle of Chen Ji was merely a foretelling of destined tragedy in its eyes.

Yet in the very instant that mocking laugh sounded, the Tianji Record Fragment glowed faintly within Chen Ji's Mental Sea. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out once more, this time carrying a rare note of approval: "Well done. Remember, the more arrogant the Heavenly Dao becomes, the more apparent its weaknesses. And your performance today has already caused it to reveal its first weakness."

The Tianji Record Fragment radiated intense heat, and a vision flickered through the Observer of Destiny's eyes. That vision, though hazy, was crucial—the moment the Heavenly Eyes attacked in its rage, its web of causality had shown a barely perceptible breach. That breach was fleeting, but Chen Ji had firmly memorized its location.

Deep within the Three Realms Causality Network, countless threads silently intertwined. Heavenly Dao's Eye coldly observed all of this, as if watching an overestimating ant. However, what it failed to notice was that those tiny cracks it had ignored were quietly expanding. The ten-thousand-year Chess Game finally saw its first crack.

Meanwhile, in an unknown corner, a pair of eyes gazed upon the heavens. It was Ling Yuan, the old Sect Master of Tianqing Sect. He looked up at the sky, a meaningful smile appearing at the corner of his lips. 'Chen Ji... you truly did not disappoint me.' he murmured, a complex light flickering in his eyes.

Above the heavens, Heavenly Dao's Eye had completely closed. Yet that cold laughter still echoed through the Causality Network, lingering endlessly. Chen Ji's fate trajectory was marked as a 'controllable variable' by it, but it did not know that this 'controllable variable' was growing at a speed beyond its prediction. The ten-thousand-year Chess Game had finally reached its most critical turning point.
